summary: This tutorial explains how to perform peer review using LibreOffice Writer's document tracking feature. It starts by opening an existing document and enabling "Record Changes" to track edits. Users can insert comments, delete text, or make changes that are clearly visible in the document. The document shows these changes in different colors for each editor, making it easy to identify who made what changes. The tutorial demonstrates adding a comment, deleting text, and inserting new text. It also shows how multiple reviewers can edit the same document simultaneously. The document being reviewed has several additions and deletions marked by the reviewer. The tutorial concludes by opening another document that has been partially reviewed, showing the tracked changes and comments from the reviewer.
